title: OmenArchive Condition
description: A condition such as frightened or prone: its rules text and the facts an app shows. Its mechanics are not part of the record yet.

valued.description: The condition carries a value (frightened 2). Left out when false.

group.description: The group of related conditions, such as attitudes or detection.

facts.description: The facts the record states about itself, which a rule can read: a name to a whole number, a flag, a term of a vocabulary, a reference to a record (omen://), or a list of these. The publication declares each fact for the record's collection in its facts; the archive check holds a value to its declaration.
